viv (People Ops): Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands. Quick post-thread to capture Q&A and next steps.

viv (People Ops): Recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/ah/1908765432

omar (Eng): Quick question — timeline for Dedicated GA mentioned as "early Q2"; can we be more specific? :eyes:

maria (CTO): We're aiming for the week of Apr 8, but that's contingent on final perf tests. If perf < 10% regression vs baseline we ship that week.

devin (Eng Lead): Perf tests scheduled Mon/Tue. I'll post results in #eng-runtime.

sophie (PM): Can we get a one-line customer-facing blurb to send partners when GA is confirmed? Something concise about capacity and SLAs.

alex (CEO): Yes. Draft: "Redwood Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity with SLA-backed latency and isolation — GA Apr week (target). Reach out for early access." @jonah please refine.

jonah (Head of Product): I'll iterate and post two variants by EOD.

sophie (PM): Thanks. Also asked during Q: will there be a migration guide for Hosted -> Dedicated? Who owns that? @maria

maria (CTO): Product docs + a short migration script. Docs owned by docs team (sophie), script by eng-tools (devin). Plan: doc + script by Apr 15.

devin (Eng Lead): Noted — I'll open a repo and stub `migrate_to_dedicated.sh` with usage. Example:
```
# migrate_to_dedicated.sh (stub)
./migrate_to_dedicated.sh --from hosted --to dedicated --config path/to/config.yaml
```

viv (People Ops): There was a question about roadmap KPIs — specifically cost/unit and p99 latency targets. @maria can you paste the targets? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria (CTO): Target cost/token: < 0.75x baseline for typical chat workloads (with batching+cache). p99 tail: < 600ms for short-turn chat (<=128 tokens) on Dedicated. These are our starting SLOs.

omar (Eng): Are there fallback policies documented if a model variant is missing? I remember automated fallbacks were demoed.

devin (Eng Lead): Yes — routing policy + compatibility table. I'll attach a one-pager in #eng-platform tomorrow.

sophie (PM): Action items recap (I'll own this thread card):
- jonah: finish partner blurb variants — due today EOD. (owner)
- devin: open repo & stub migration script — due Apr 15.
- devin: perf test result post in #eng-runtime — due Tue.
- maria: confirm GA week once perf passes — target Apr 8 week.
- jonah/sophie: migration doc + customer-facing FAQ — due Apr 15.

viv (People Ops): If anyone wants to be added as an owner or has corrections, reply here. I'll convert this to a Notion card and tag owners.

alex (CEO): Appreciate the speed. Good all-hands. :rocket:

allhands-bot: Recording processed and available at https://redwood.example.com/ah/1908765432 (transcript ready).

omar (Eng): small ask — can we get the demo repo link in the thread so our partners can repro the Dedicated perf numbers?

jonah (Head of Product): I'll share the demo repo link when I post the blurb variants. Will ping again.

viv (People Ops): Thanks — closing the loop for now. I'll update the Notion with these items and notify owners. :white_check_mark:
